method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator or service pages, Companies House, Charity Commission, CQC and official council routes are promoted. Directory-only claims and search snippets are rejected.
method.filing_freshness_policy: A live Companies House overview and filing history control over an earlier support narrative. Missing filings after their statutory due dates are recorded as current corporate-risk amendments without implying cessation of trading.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
